title: עוגה

items: במקום קמח תופח אפשר 2 כוסות קמח [crossed-out word] + 2 כפיות אבקת אפיה

notes: Title 'עוגה' and source 'שרה ...' are on the top line, separated by a slash.

The card is a single running list mixing ingredients and method lines (e.g. 'להקציף חלבון + 1 כוס סוכר'); it is kept in card order under ingredients. A horizontal line divides the card; two hard-to-read lines below it (probably method) precede '2 כוסות קמח תופח', which ends the card at the bottom edge. No baking temperature/time is written.

A second-opinion transcription (gemini_transcribtion.txt) adds full method steps, vanilla/rum and 'קמח אוסם'; most of that is not visible on the card and was not used except as best_guess where partly consistent with the crops.
Independent reread confirmed לקציפה קשה and תפוזים; other shaky words remain flagged.
Source set by the owner (issue #324): שרה רוט.

The recipe continues on a second card (scan -19, previously the separate record b01-r20, PR #24): the first card ends with '2 כוסות קמח תופח' and the second says 'במקום קמח תופח אפשר 2 כוסות קמח + 2 כפיות אבקת אפיה'. Noticed by the owner as the second part of a recipe; merged on 2026-10-06. The id b01-r20 is intentionally unused.
